features.label: Human-reported condition (1-4)
features.how: Worst rating word in 'Reported condition rating_raw' mapped to the rubric: good/satisfactory/excellent=1, fair=2, poor=3, serious/severe/critical/very poor=4. NBI digits: >=6 ->1, 5 ->2, 4 ->3, <=3 ->4.

features.label: Action urgency (0-3)
features.how: 'Defect Severity/ Action urgency': minor/low/monitor=1, moderate/priority=2, urgent/severe/immediate=3.

features.label: Material: steel
features.how: Primary or secondary material text matches /steel/.

features.label: Material: concrete
features.how: Primary or secondary material text matches /concre?te|concete/.

features.label: Material: timber
features.how: Primary or secondary material text matches /timber|wood/.

features.label: Material: stone / masonry
features.how: Primary or secondary material text matches /granite|stone|rock|masonry|brick/.

features.label: Material: rubber
features.how: Primary or secondary material text matches /rubber/.

features.label: Saltwater or brackish exposure
features.how: 'Exposure environment' mentions saltwater or brackish (vs freshwater).

features.label: Zone: submerged
features.how: 'Exposure zone' matches /submerged/.

features.label: Zone: splash / tidal
features.how: 'Exposure zone' matches /splash|tidal|tial\b/.

features.label: Zone: above / water
features.how: 'Exposure zone' matches /above water/.

features.label: Underwater inspection
features.how: 'Inspection type' mentions underwater, dive or Level I/II.

features.label: Not a condition inspection
features.how: 'Inspection type' is a proposal, memo, guidance manual, planning or vulnerability study.

features.label: Defect: steel
features.how: 'Defect type(s)' matches /steel/.

features.label: Defect: concrete
features.how: 'Defect type(s)' matches /concrete|crack|spall/.

features.label: Defect: timber
features.how: 'Defect type(s)' matches /timber/.

features.label: Defect: connection
features.how: 'Defect type(s)' matches /connection|hardware/.

features.label: Defect: soil / water / loss
features.how: 'Defect type(s)' matches /soil|void|water loss/.

features.label: Defect: movement
features.how: 'Defect type(s)' matches /movement|displac|tilt/.

features.label: Number of defect types
features.how: Count of defect-type flags above.

features.label: Number of defects (log)
features.how: log(1 + first number in 'Number_defects'); NR = missing.

features.label: Repairs since previous inspection
features.how: 'Repairs since previous inspection' starts with yes/partial = 1, no = 0, unknown = missing.

features.label: Inspection year
features.how: First year in 'Inspection date', else the year in the PDF filename.

features.label: Human fields filled (of 18)
features.how: How many of the 18 human fields are not empty/NR/not stated.

features.label: Report length, pages (log)
features.how: log(PDF pages).

features.label: Scored in several pieces
features.how: Report text exceeded 250,000 characters, so the score is the worst piece.
